blind.B1: Yes. Soleus RNA-seq of 12-week WT and mD3AKO mice at rest (sham treadmill) vs 60 min after a 30-min treadmill bout (S4.3.p1, S2.2.p2). All 25 samples are sequenced; the exercise factor is the 60 vs rest timepoint, crossed with genotype and sex.
blind.B2: Exercise main effect (60 min vs rest, pooled over genotype and sex), genotype main effect (KO vs WT), genotype x exercise interaction (S2.2.p2, S4.17.p1). Fig 2 legend: n = 5-7 per group; GEO cells WT rest 5, WT ex60 7, KO rest 7, KO ex60 6.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one soleus per mouse, N = individual animals (S4.17.p1). Titles carry a unique mouse number 1-25. source_name_ch1 repeats within levels and is a group label, not an animal.
blind.B4: Joint model: DE tested for main effects of genotype, exercise and their interaction (S4.17.p1: 'analysed for a main effect of genotype, a main effect of exercise and a genotype/exercise interaction'). Software and sex handling not stated (ref [34]).
blind.B5: S4.17.p1: 'A false discovery rate (FDR) of less than 5% was considered significant.' No fold-change cutoff stated. Counts: 1615 exercise DEGs, 56 genotype DEGs, 0 interaction DEGs (S2.2.p2, FDR 5%).

summary: 该案例的运行决定、分组、方向、模型结构和阈值转录均与论文一致，没有重复测量，性别与各因素交叉，不构成混杂。总体通过；仅有一个次要项：基因型 130 对 56 的差异与 |lfc|>0.585 规则相近，但论文未写该规则，建议在差异记录中补充一句。
